svg.title: A terminal typing out what this account is for
svg.desc: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 🧹 Untangling what people forget / 🧭 Written rules over heroics / 🗺️ Set up with one flag / 🪵 The whole story in one query / 🔗 No action without a review / 📮 A change that arrives tested / 🛠️ Fix the cause, not the symptom / 🧰 Choices I would make again / 🩺 Catch it before the pager does / 🧩 Pieces that fit by contract / 🏗️ Leave the safe way easy / 🎯 Covers exactly what it claims

g.text: 🪵 The whole story in one query
🛠️ Fix the cause, not the symptom
🩺 Catch it before the pager does
